text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp is finally underway! 
With the Leopard Stakes just around the 
corner, what is Hokko Tarumae up to—

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I made it safely to the training lodge~! 
Starting today, I'm havin' my summer 
training camp here too, y'all!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna train a whole bunch and get way 
stronger, so look forward to it, okay? ♪

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep posting updates from our 
training, so I hope everyone leaves 
cheering comments with 
#HangInThereTarumae!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Thank you! —All right, that takes care of 
the start of training camp.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even during the training camp, Hokko 
Tarumae enthusiastically carried out 
promotional activities.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
—The behind-the-scenes training footage 
has gotten great reception, so let's keep 
posting during summer training camp to 
drum up even more attention.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course training comes first, okay? 
The Leopard Stakes is just around the 
corner!
choice_data_list: Let's really push ourselves to the limit!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: Yes, please take care of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the intense summer training camp 
begins...!!
